title: Building – Storage Racks – April 2023
description: The City of Calgary ordered a tire business to obtain a permit and compliance for free-standing tire storage racks in its building. The racks are stacked and moved by forklift and not anchored.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an s.49 order

outcome_summary: Order varied: the portable racks are not subject to the Act or Code. The appellant must still have a valid permit for the building's configuration (scope excluding the racks) and arrange inspection by 24 June 2023.
